# `aitbc wallet import-wallet`

Import a wallet from a JSON file with an optional new name.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet import-wallet [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file-path` | text | — | yes | Path to the file. |
| `--name` | text | — | no | New wallet name (default: from file) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet import-wallet --file-path <file_path>
```
